category_level_B_support_to_C_need_gap_c.interpretation: Category-level aggregate perspective-gap candidates across B supervisor support-state blocks and C worker need/usefulness blocks. These are safer for first-pass profiling than item-number matches.

preserve_as_signal_not_noise: B/C support-need perspective gaps only after category or item alignment is reviewed
B problem resolved/unresolved states in C-1 through C-4 blocks
B work participation constraint states in D-1 through D-12 blocks
C job satisfaction as one participation-quality signal, never as proof of job quality
B/C disability-code differences after linkage QA as possible coding-perspective signal, not automatic error

recommended_analysis_sets.strict_triad_set: A+B+C pairs with non-missing keys; keep disability/severity mismatch as flags, not default exclusion.
recommended_analysis_sets.B_C_pair_set: B+C overlap pairs for supervisor-person perspective gap analysis; use A context when present.
recommended_analysis_sets.B_only_set: Supervisor-only records for worksite-contact distribution, not perspective-gap claims.
recommended_analysis_sets.C_only_set: Worker-only records for need/usefulness and satisfaction distribution, not supervisor-person mismatch claims.
recommended_analysis_sets.A_establishment_only_set: Organization context and burden/advice-use distribution; never individual outcome evidence.
